# opnsense_caddy_domain (Data Source)

Reads a Caddy domain by UUID. Dynamically generated certificate ownership cannot be inferred for imported or data-source-only domains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_caddy_domain" "application" {
  id = var.domain_id
}
```
